mentioned.quote: xAI treats AI-accelerated malicious cyber offense as a core risk domain.

threshold.note: No specific level defined for this risk. p.6 refers to 'whether a threshold has been reached' and 'the risk tiers for each systemic risk category', and p.8 to 'alerting of threshold breaches', but no threshold or tier is ever stated.

response.quote: xAI will only proceed with the development, the making available on the market, and/or the use of the model, if the systemic risks stemming from the model are determined to be acceptable.
response.note: Generic acceptance gate, counted under E3.

acc_decider.note: No named role or body. p.6 'The final decision also reflects an overall judgment' names no decider; p.8 'designating risk owners' is generic; p.9 'internal governance structures' unnamed.

acc_external.note: No committed external review. p.6 takes into account 'human expert red-teaming' without saying it is external or committing to it; p.8-9 reporting incidents to authorities is notification only (C5).

acc_unmet.note: Only the E3 acceptance gate (p.6), which E4 excludes. No statement of what happens if named safeguards cannot be put in place; p.6 options are hedged ('xAI may'); p.8 incident responses are hedged ('we may'); p.9 'legal and compliance reviews' names no reporting or investigation of non-compliance.
